newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end sharply down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end sharply down on profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended sharply down on Friday due to profit-taking in blue chips before the weekend, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-index ended 58.40 points, or 2.94 percent, down at 1,931.11 at the close at 12.10 p.m. (0710 GMT). Losers led gainers 147 to 27.
Profit-taking in blue chips was the main reason for the fall, a dealer at Fortune Securities said.
Pakistan State Oil closed 10 rupees lower at 415, Engro Chemical eight down at 163 and Fauji Fertiliser fell 4.00 to 88.
